reviews.text: honestly There are so many better places to go .  This is the kind of place that is 100% going to lie to you. At first, they were great. The appointment went fine until it came to the fact that it was a free appointment and then suddenly it got weird. The vet tech said she needed to speak to a manager. After I waited for nearly 30 minutes For her to speak to somebody The medication Plan changed And the That tech made me super uncomfortable They changed the medication from a pill to a liquid And she kept repeating this is way based you can’t give it to your other cat And she said it multiple times, which made me feel a little off about the situation. Fun fact My other cat had an appointment two days later because before she came back out, I was like oh wow, I like this place they Don’t seem terrible. But yeah, after that I just wanted to get out of there Because I was so uncomfortable. I’d rather just go to Logan Square vet or Wacker Park vet Their offices may not be the nicest in the fanciest, but they’re honest people.

Have been to this vet a few times now and they have always been very nice and accommodating. However, I took one star away because I had to rush my cat in for a walk-in appointment and nowhere on the website or when we came in did they say anything about walk-ins being $145. I was already halfway through the appointment when someone told me and it was too late at that point. I want to make sure people are aware of this price ahead of time.

Hello Kris S,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a perfect 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Wicker Park. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care for your pets, and your feedback truly means a lot to us. If you ever have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friends again soon!

Warm regards,  
The Bond Vet - Wicker Park Team
i was amazed at how little i had to wait during my appointment. also everyone was very nice and very competent.

The staff at Bond Vet seems very kind, but I still will be finding another vet. Dr. Kim told me to use ChatGBT to figure out a diet plan for my cat. To me, it seemed that AI was integrated into the entire office visit, which was incredibly offputting to me. If AI usage is something you are conscious of, I would not recommend this office.

Our puppy Elvis has loved coming to this bond vet location since we brought him home and is truly loved on more than we could have ever asked for. Juria, Reuben, and Dr. Fitzsimmons take the BEST care of him - he gets so so happy to see them every single visit and vice versa. They all also have always been wonderful and reassuring to us as pet (and puppy) parents. We’ll never go to a different vet as long as we live in Chicago and could not recommend this office more
The doctors and nurses are all very sweet! The service and explaination was perfectly understandable, and well broken down.
Great place: we were in and out in less than a half hour and the first exam was free! Will be back for all our pets needs
They were very kind.  If you need s place to take your pet this is it.

I brought in a stray kitten that I found crying and severely dehydrated at my workplace, and the entire experience was absolutely wonderful. From the incredibly friendly reception staff to the nurses and doctors, everyone was so kind and took amazing care of this sweet little girl. It turns out she has a broken leg and a busted toe, so we are currently looking into our options, but I am so incredibly grateful for the wonderful care she received here. On top of the exceptional service, their pricing was very reasonable. Thank you all so much for helping her!

Took my dog here a couple months ago for a checkup on his ear - the dr checked his ear briefly and noted its just dirty nothing to be weary about. Mention its repeated and needed to be swabbed dr stated it did not... 2 months later took him to PETSMART... PETSMART for them to say he has a sever infection that is now spreading to another ear... waste of money. And my dog is hurting, wouldn't recommend.

Firstly, the only reason I didn't give this business a fifth star is due to its location in the middle of a busy city block. The lack of dedicated and convenient parking is a significant detractor. Our dog initially received her care in the Northern suburbs at the Glenview locale, which has since been shuttered, and it's a great shame, because everybody we've dealt with at both that location and most recently the Wicker Park center has demonstrated kindness and care toward our intellectually challenged chocolate Labrador Retriever. The massive (and thoroughly commonplace) traffic snarl that we experienced on the highway going from our Glenview home to Wicker Park was impetus to find a vet closer to home, but if not for the distance involved and the aforementioned parking issue, we'd be happy to have Brooklyn keep being treated by the good folks at Bond Vet.

Wonderful staff and wonderful experience. Incredibly caring and kind. They were very quick to answer any and all questions I had. Their pricing was incredibly clear and transparent as well as their care being quick thorough and loving towards my little kitty! Genuinely the best vet experience of my life! Thank you so much!!

Bondvet Wicker has been great. Dr. Klein and all the stuff are super understanding of my fussy pup and always help her feel comfortable. They’ve been quick to act during potential emergencies and are are always reachable. Highly recommend. Moving out of the state but if I was staying my dog would still be receiving her care here.

This place is a money trap they have a charge for every little thing, as soon as I walked in I had a bad feeling. It’s one of the places that is more for dogs than for cats. They charge you an eye and a leg for everything. Paid $235 for a booster shot & a poop sample. Did this at another vet for my other cat and did not pay more than $85. For sure never coming back.

Worst booking and customer service. First they tell me online via email they do surgery by the hour but proceed to text me a link to an itemized bill which they noted they do not do. Then I book with their new client promo which offers a free exam. Day of the appointment I get no email confirmation just a text no address so my mom ends up going to the wrong place. We explain and they say ok, I’m livid and I tell them I’m not paying a dime for a late fee when they didn’t email me and it’s not my fault they rely on AI and can’t handle customer service. I rebook same day and they have the nerve to charge me $50. Nope.

A vet here told me that my 12-year-old cat's new habit of going to the restroom outside the litter box was behavioral.

I took her to a second vet who believes she may have cancer. An ultrasound (at the recommendation of the 2nd vet, never once suggested by the vet here) is pointing to this being likely, with a biopsy likely to have to occur in multiple parts of her abdomen.

If you care about your pet's health, I'd advise taking them elsewhere.

Came here for a quick appointment because my dog was puking throughout the night and had bits of blood in his puke. I appreciate the transparent pricing and ease of the visit.

However, the vet tech strangely acted as though she was the doctor. She provided out of place advice and diagnosis in response to my answers to her questions. I was so surprised when she said she was going to go get the doctor. Entire visit was 85% the tech talking and taking basic intake and 15% the actual doctor's input. It wasn't busy... Overpriced and over-prescribed the treatment.

Nice staff. Seemed fresh out of school - to be expected at a chain vet. Went here last min because my vet was closed. Told me my dachshund probably had IVDD (common in dachshunds) I knew he didn’t because we’d been through that before. Took him to my normal vet he ended up having a tooth infection :/ seemed like they saw a dachshund and jumped to IVDD immediately. Glad we didn’t do 2 weeks crate rest like they recommended.

Hello Camille,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a wonderful 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Wicker Park. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care possible for your pets, and it's always rewarding to know that our efforts are appreciated. If you ever have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friends again soon!

Warm regards,  
The Bond Vet - Wicker Park Team
The staff and the doctor's are amazing

THIS PLACE IS AMAZING from the scheduling , to check in , to triaging and exam was the most smoothest visit my dog has ever had. He has bad anxiety when seeing other dogs. And this place did everything to accommodate my dog to his liking I appreciate the staff like no other 💙 the vet assistant who took care of my doggie was amazing I don’t remember her name😥 but she works wonders 💗

Incredible experience
My cat was very sick
They got me right in
Very kind, knowledgeable and informative
Front desk, assistant and vet were all helpful and explained everything well
I followed vets recommendations and my kitty was better in a day
They even had a medication Ubered from another office  to their office so I could pick up same day
Highly recommend!

Dear Laura,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a perfect 5-star review! We are thrilled to hear that you had a positive experience at Bond Vet - Wicker Park. Our team is dedicated to providing the best care possible for your furry family members, and your feedback truly means a lot to us.

If you ever have any questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out. We look forward to seeing you and Wednesday again soon!

Warm regards,

The Bond Vet - Wicker Park Team

When our previous location (Glenview) closed, we came here and knew the second we met Dr. Fitzsimmons this was going to become our new location. Our boy is what you might call a "frequent flyer" with his issues and everyone knows and loves him. I have never met a dog so happy to go to the vet. They are so caring and will go above and beyond for you and your pet! Love them!
My partner and I had a great experience here! The vet was able to see us right away when our dog Diane got sick and she loved all the staff.

Incredible vet!! I brought my senior cat in for facial swelling. They found he had bad dental disease and were able to get him in quick for a cleaning. They explained the process, and gave me resources to help cover the cost. They made a stressful situation so seamless. He had some teeth pulled and everything healed so well and he is now acting half his age!! He is feeling so much better and I cannot thank the staff enough!

We went to Bond Vet for the first time today and our experience was nothing short of incredible. My dog Meadow has had serious anxiety issues when going to other vets. We made the staff aware of this when scheduling our appointment and everyone from reception to the veterinary staff made her feel right at home. It was a breath of fresh air to see how much everyone there cared about her and made her feel comfortable instead of treating her visit like a financial transaction.
They made my dog feel super comfortable and will be making this my home vet !
The whole clinic is very clean and welcoming. The staff was great with my new puppy and answered all of my questions. We’ll be switching our older dog to get her care here too!
My dog loves it here! They are so friendly and always do a great job. Highly recommend!
They’re great with our cat and our dog, reasonably priced and transparent about costs.
I've been bringing my pets to this location for several years. The staff and doctors are all more than willing to help and answer all of my questions.
I’ve had great experience! Everyone was really helpful!
Highly recommend!
Great service and lovely people

Hi, My Name is Bryan Victoria. I say this veterinary is, if not one of the best I’ve ever been too! They give you the best recommendations for your best friend! They saved my Dogs life with their amazing team that took action immediately and did surgery on my best friend, they gave the best reasonable price for it too! VetBond is not only a veterinarian place but a community that offers care and support for your best friend! 100/10!! Will be coming back for anything! The team is caring,resilient, and although obstacles may appear they will handle everything to their best of their ability! Thank you VetBond for saving my best buddy Jack! We are grateful to you all!

After having some less than ideal experiences with other vets, I decided to try BondVet in Wicker Park and now will never go anywhere else. My dog has a lot of anxiety about going to the vet, and the whole staff has been patient and kind to him every time we go there. Specifically Alexis, Lisandra and Dr. Fitzsimmons always go above and beyond to make sure that he is comfortable. Even after we leave the appointment, Dr. Fitzsimmons follows up personally to make sure that he is doing ok.

Bringing him to the vet used to be a nerve-racking experience for me, but BondVet has made it something that I actually look forward to when it is time for my dog to have his regular visits. Thank you!

I went to BondVet when my cat was dying and they did everything right. I could list all of the things they did, but it wouldn't accurately capture the compassion and grace I was shown.

After she died, they let me bring her in so I could find a place for her to be buried. They let me stay in one of the exam rooms for a time and several workers came in to talk/check in. Every person I interacted with was extremely kind, beyond anything that one could expect.

I had a day's worth of advice via texts, several phone conversations, one vet exam, an hour or two worth of exam room time spent mourning, pre-burial holding, and a paw print, and the total cost? $0. They didn't charge me anything when they easily could have. I still would have given them a great review, but this was above and beyond.

They helped my best friend and I during an extremely dark time, and I'll never forget it. From the bottom of my heart, thank you all.
Second surgery with Bond. Professional, caring, compassionate veterinarians and overall staff. I have appreciated their support and knowledge. Gemma and I are very grateful!

I'm a new patient (my cat) and today was my 2nd visit, and I'm very happy with this clinic staff's clear communication about costs and options. Their flexible hours and easy appointment requests online are helpful too.

I don’t know what it is about businesses  not wanting to actually speak on the phone anymore but when I first called just to ask some questions about services, I was immediately speaking with AI….. Then, when I asked to speak to a person, it put me on hold for a few minutes and went to voicemail. Disappointing.

**Compassionate Care & Zero Pressure
If you need a vet in Wicker Park, go to Bond Vet.**

Their customer service is superb, and the atmosphere is so welcoming for both pets and owners. I was seriously impressed by how the vet spent so much time explaining options without any of the typical "up-sale" pressure found elsewhere.

They even honored a free first visit promo and sent us home with everything we needed for my dog's health. Magnificent staff and total peace of mind.

**Highly recommend for wellness exams or urgent care!**
Lisandra provides efficient, communicative service with great character. I've yet to have any type of problems coming to this vet.
Superrr sweet people, they loveeeee dogs

Awful. Messed up my dog stool sample results and my daughter’s dog. They never called to tell us it was positive and they needed antibiotics.  Everytime we have minor things like a shot or still sample for daycare they charge for a full visit. Can’t make sn appointment and walk out spending less than $300 All they care about is overcharging people.

I had a really great experience at Bond Vet in Wicker Park. The entire team was incredibly patient and understanding, especially knowing that my dog Chicken struggles with anxiety. Both the vet and the vet tech were amazing — calm, kind, and very, very good with him, which made such a difference in helping him feel safe.

They took the time to walk me through everything and provided so many helpful tools, guidance, and support so I can help Chicken continue working toward being happy and healthy. I truly felt listened to and cared for as a pet parent. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a compassionate and knowledgeable team!

Took care of my cane corso and made my day and starting her recovery as I speak and the doctors did the unthinkable for me it literally brought tears to my eyes and I officially love this place and I highly recommend for the love of your pet

Awesome experience, wish there was more parking around though but the inside looks nice and the staff is extremely friendly and helpful with everything. I also like how bond vet always breaks down cost and asks before proceeding with anything in medication and even works with you in finding alternatives as well to save money. They are true friends for pets and pet owners.

I've been taking my dog here for years. Everyone working there is very friendly and welcoming. I never wait for more than a few minutes and the doctors and technicians are thorough, they ask questions and listen. Exams and vaccines typically take less then 30 minutes.

My dog Spot has seen Dr. Klein too many x’s to count over the past few months. First of all, I’m so thankful for the no-visit fee for new clients, and secondly, the availability, kind staff, and care that have been given to Spot are greatly appreciated. Dr. Klein was spot on with diagnosis, and patient with a fluctuating treatment plan. My senior dog requires more attention these days, and she is helping us through the process.
The staff and doctors were wonderful! My pup was treated well, the doctors were kind and thorough. They check up on your pet. I’d absolutely go back.
They are so amazing with my cat!
Amazing Vet, so helpful and everyone working there so nice and kind. Prices are acceptable and clinic is clean…
Been going here for 3 years… Great work with my cat Georgie!
Roofio felt the care & love. Thank you to the whole staff.

Had a great time at bondvet wicker park! They handled my cat with care, and informed me of all options to get my cat the care she needs. The doctor was very informative, and took her time educating me on cat health. Will be back for future vet visits!
Great experience and caring, knowledgeable staff.
Wonderful concept and smart promotion for first-time visits.
Everyone at Bond Vet was amazing with our brand new puppy. We look forward to many more visits there.

Soulless, corporatized veterinary care for masochists
—

I have been a client at this location since adopting our puppy from a local rescue. I was excited to find a reputable brand, with good reviews, in the neighborhood.

Our first visit went reasonably well. The vet and technicians were kind.

Having access to “free” examinations for the year feels like a nice perk, but it’s quickly apparent that they intend to make up for this cost by charging exorbitant fees for lab work and medications. Hundreds of dollars in unnecessary blood tests, liver tests, anything you can think of to try and separate you from your money.

The online scheduling is a nice feature, and a benefit of attending a chain like this; however, calling into the office, for anything, is an exercise in frustration. I have never felt more disrespected by medical staff than I have at Bond Vet; they are argumentative, rude, and have never once acted like they care about my pet or his health.

Q: “My dog ate something he shouldn’t have, could I speak to someone about if it’s potentially harmful?”

A: No, we won’t help you. Call the poison control center and figure out what you need to do by yourself.
—
Q: “Can my dog have this medication, which has been prescribed by you before for this issue, and is the first line and most common treatment?”

A: No. Despite being an established client, you must come in and pay for needless lab work, then we’ll give you the medication regardless of the test result.
—
Q: “Can I speak to the veterinarian?”

A: No, they don’t want to speak with you. In fact, they’d rather leave a passive aggressive message and have their PR person call you instead — to lie about the care they’re capable of providing.

—

Avoid this location and chain if you care about your pet — or if you want your veterinary team to care about your pet.

Everything I’ve written here is based on my own experience. When reading their corporate response to this review, keep in mind: all they care about is their bottom line.

We took our cat to Bond Vet Wicker Park for her 1-year vaccines. While the clinic itself is beautiful and very clean, the service felt impersonal and cold. We didn’t feel that there was any effort to build a connection with us or with our pet. The experience was efficient, but lacking warmth and care, which is something important to us when trusting someone with our cat.
We took Jiji here and they cared for her like no other!

Been coming here since I had an emergency with my pup. The staff has always been super helpful and when they couldn’t give me answers, they directed me to a specialist that could (and quickly). Ever since, I’ve been coming here for anything and everything and they really treat my little one as one of their own. Will continue to come here as it’s one of the cleanest vets I’ve been too in a long time

Hi Christian, 
We’re very sorry to see your review and would like the opportunity to learn more about your experience. Your feedback is important to us, and we’d appreciate it if you could contact us directly with your account information so we can better understand what happened.
Sincerely, 
The Bond Vet Team
Always leaving with a happy and healthy dog
Great place super attentive awesome
Bind vet office in Wicker Park is awesome… staff is incredible, kind, polite and Dr. Klein is thorough & treats your pet as if it was her own.

I take both my dogs and cats to Bond, and the experience is consistently excellent. The team is always kind, efficient, and transparent—they go over everything with you ahead of time and make sure you feel informed and comfortable. Appointments are quick but thorough, and my pets are always well cared for. Highly recommend!
I’ve been bringing my dog here for over a year and just brought my cat for the first time. The staff is friendly and very communicative. They did a great job with both my cat and dog!
Bond Vet was fantastic! They explained everything super well and made my dog feel super safe.
Great environment and super friendly team.
Wonderful staff, always an excellent experience!
Amazing super friendly and kind service, very helpful and accommodating :)
Facilities are always clean and easy to access! Wells loves all the staff and they are very communicative! They are very helpful with any and all concerns!

I've been a Bond customer for about one year. The staff is kind and knowledgeable, their rates feel reasonable, and most importantly my dog is always happy to go there even after receiving a few vaccines.

Scheduling is easy, but keep in mind the Wicker Park/Bucktown location is closed on Sundays as of this writing in July 2025. Their other Chicago location is in Lakeview is open on Sundays. Gold Coast is not.

Bond recently launched a text message line for customers to schedule appointments, ask questions, and report issues they want added to their pets' records. I've used it several times and found it convenient.

Overall I'm satisfied and plan to continue bringing my pet to Bond for care. I'd recommend them to others.

Disclosure: I wrote this review as part of a promotion, but the promotion did not influence my review.
Have been going to this location for two years now, the staff is always great and work well with my nervous dog!
friendly staff that are really good with animals!
Friendly staff and knowledgeable care! Highly recommend for the Bucktown/Wicker neighbors!
Great, thorough service!  Very good with animals.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for his overgrown nail trims for almost a year now. This has been the BEST vet by far. I’ve gone to two other vets where they’ve actually hurt him more and trimmed too short which led to bleeding and him limping. I have had ZERO issues here. It’s a drive for me, but anything for my furry best friend.
The staff here are super kind and take great care of our pup! He loves going for visits.
Friendly, quick, and great care!
Great service. Nice to my dog. Easy and Quick appointment
Bond Vet is great and they really know their stuff. So friendly with my dog too. Don’t think I will be going any where else soon.

Taco loves BondVet! The staff is so sweet and the office is cute and welcoming. We love how they give you an estimate for costs before deciding on anything - no surprise bills! Hands down the best vet we have experienced.

We LOVE our Bond Vet Wicker Park location! We have been going to this location for the last 1.5 years, since we got our cat, JJ; and it has been such a wonderful experience. The vets are lovely, they are transparent about their prices, and they really seem to care about the pets. I feel so lucky to have such great pet care at Bond Vet!

Bond Vet in Wicker Park has been great for my elderly cat. She needs more frequent visits, so the online scheduling is perfect. Everyone treats her so well and she gets the care she needs easily. My questions are answered and they follow up as needed. Everyone is friendly and helps explain all costs before procedures. The online pharmacy is also easy to use and convenient for refills. Would recommend for your neighborhood vet.
Thorough, great communication, great with our anxious pups, accommodating and flexible. Easy to book appointments not far out.
They’re very nice, got my cat in for a visit very quickly and treated her well.

I couldn’t recommend this place enough to others. The staff through and through is so knowledgeable, accommodating, and communicative. They make the entire process for not only owners but your pet as well so easy and comfortable. I personally have a pretty anxious cat so typically vet appointments I’ll run into a lot of obstacles and it’s normally was a process I used to dread, this place completely changed my mindset about it and maybe even my stubborn cat as well haha. Alexis at the front desk is phenomenal- so sweet, and professional. Thank you guys so much and to anyone reading no need to be apprehensive booking your appointment!
Very friendly and was able to see my pet right at schedule time. Answered all my questions!

We have been coming to Bond Vet Wicker Park since our lab mix Roscoe was a little guy, and they are always so friendly and compassionate. They have great treats on hand for dogs and cats (dried turkey and salmon), and the waiting area and rooms are super comfortable. I am also able to book appointments online and get in quickly. Highly recommend this vet clinic!!
Excellent vet! They are always on time, very easy to schedule, and are patient with all of the paranoid pet owner questions that I always bombard them with :)
Quincy and I love it here! This team is very attentive - best vet experience we’ve had in quite some time.

Love, love all the people at Bond Vet: doctors, techs, reception. After helping us to help our dog navigate a persistent lick wound, they've become our regular vet. Recommend the Wicker Park location highly!

Bond vet was amazing! My kitten had been having tummy troubles and we weren't established anywhere yet, and I needed to get her somewhere quick! They were super easy to get a last minute appointment with, and extremely friendly. When evaluating her, they gave me every option and route we could go down to help her, and were helpful in what measures I could take without pushing me to put her through too many expensive diagnostics. We gave her some deworming medicine, B12 and fluids, took home some probiotics, and brought in a stool sample. Within a day we figured out the root of her tummy problems! After the first day of her medicine she's eating much better and seems a lot more energetic!

I brought my cat here when he had an emergency urinary episode. I was in absolute panic, crying and freaking out. Dr. Klein and the whole staff treated me so kindly, patiently, and without judgement. I bring him here for regular checkups and vaccines now because I know I can trust them. The location is spacious, clean, and inviting. Thank you Dr. Klein!
Excellent experience! Very caring and always on time.

5 Stars is simply not enough. First, they had Sunday hours, that deserves 10 stars right there. My 10 yo Cane Corso with arthritis needed to be seen due to shaking in hind legs as well as they were giving out on him. He is not socialized but Dr. Klein and the techs were AMAZING. Our normal vet does not have Sunday hours but the visit, treatment and the fact they weren't fazed by him, that alone was enough to change his provider. Dr. Klein walked us through everything. We walked in not knowing if we would have to make the other choice but she provided options to give us more time, and we are grateful. I cannot recommend Bond Vet enough. Thank you Dr. Klein and the staff who were all courteous, beginning to the end.
They were so kind to our little cat jones. I couldn’t recommend them enough!

High quality, personalized care for both dogs and cats. I’ve been to many veterinary offices trying to find someone to give my large dog a FULL EXAM. The care my dog received from Dr. Fitzsimmons is unmatched.
We then brought in our SENIOR cat, we got immediate answers for his weight loss and medication right away.
The cost of care seems to be exactly what I paid at places WAY less qualified. All vets are not equal, if you care about your animal bring them to BOND. Dr. Fitzsimmons and Dr. Berlin are phenomenal ❤️🐱🐕

I cannot recommend Bond Vet more. I supported a community member with getting an appointment for her sick cat day-of and this was one of the only clinics in the area that had availability. Cost was prohibitive for her, and the Bond team was so compassionate, empathetic and respectful, and provided exceptional care despite her limited budget. They continued to check in on her and her cat, providing recommendations as her cat neared the end of his life. I know that this community member will always remember the care provided by the Bond team. Additionally, I plan to bring my pets to Bond if we're ever not able to get in with our regular provider.

We have had 3 amazing experiences here. The staff is so kind, the office is clean and appointments are so quick. Dr. Fitzsimmons is the best vet we’ve seen with our puppy. She always makes sure every question is answered, she sits on the floor to comfort and play with your animals and I leave with a weight off my chest that my dog is healthy and was happy/never scared to go to vet! We came in one night, late, with an emergency and they took us right away, got started on treating our girl and called an emergency vet hospital to get us in ASAP with them. They also followed up with texts and calls to check on our puppy after we went to the vet hospital. Seriously love having such a good vet.

If I were to rate Bond Vet solely on the level of care provided by the doctor and the vet tech, I would give it a 5. The latter were wonderful, so much so that I was hoping to make Bond my primary vet. Disconcertingly, half way through the appointment, I realized that I and my animals were under video surveillance in the exam room. This upset me, to say the least, and really creeped me out. My cat had her mammary glands checked, as one was bleeding, and the kitten had her gender confirmed. This was all done under video surveillance; I was not informed of this when making the appointment, and neither did I consent to being recorded in the exam room, or to having my animals recorded while they were being checked out, turned upside down, sensitive parts exposed, etc.

When I called a few days later to speak to them about it, the woman who answered seemed to think that it was unreasonable for me to be upset that the exam room had a video camera in it. She told me that it was for their safety, and that it was also for my safety. She then emphasized that the lobby also had security cameras. I am accustomed to areas like lobbies having video surveillance, but a medical exam room?? The quote they gave me to have my cat spayed was in the range of $1,000. I would like to think that a facility that feels itself to be of such high caliber that they can charge that kind of money to spay a cat would also have top notch employees; personnel mature enough not to require governance by nanny cam.

To add to my discomfort, the cash payment I provided was not given change, so I said, okay, please credit the balance to my account. The woman who took my cash payment agreed to do so, hence my surprise a day or so later when I received a message from Bond stating that my account was unpaid. What?! I had to take time in the middle of the work day to call them, which I did as I was concerned that the money had somehow gone missing. When informed of the payment discrepancy, the front desk person said the account did not show that I paid $180 cash, and she said the “cash is in a lock box so I will have to to talk to manager”. She also told me that their system “handles cash differently”, whatever that means, and seemed to think that I should have somehow known that or anticipated that since I made the poor choice of paying with cash that issues were to be expected. I have zero tolerance for younger people who are in customer service roles of any kind and don’t even know how to count money, make change, or file payments correctly. I checked their website before going in to make sure that there was not the dreaded “card only” nonsense, and I even called to check if they took cash. I was told yes they took cash, and not yes, but expect it to be put in a lock box and forgotten about while we send you a payment overdue notice.

The front desk person did say she would speak to management about my concerns regarding being recorded, but this clinic seems to be on the new world order tip with lack of privacy and the “cash is trash” mentality, so I doubt I will go back. I am sad to say so, as their rates for emergency appointments are much more affordable than the 24/7 ER clinics, and the clinic was very nice and comfortable inside. I really liked the doctor and the vet tech, but taking video of my animals while they were being examed, and then trying to double charge me, may be too deterring to ever feel comfortable returning to Bond.
Everyone is always friendly and welcoming. They're very transparent with pricing and when mentioning having cost concerns they try and work with you.

Premium prices for below average knowledge and information. Amazing experience at Bond Vet-Wicker Park. My puppy wasn’t feeling good and they really listened to my concerns. They were good at reassuring me and offered great solutions for my puppy’s care! Thank you Bond Vet team, you were so nice and welcoming ❤️

We took our dog to get a rabies vaccine yesterday.  Our dog is very anxious and reactive. The staff was patient and quick. The prices weren't too high and they gave us a prescription for her anxiety as well.

Great experience. Scheduling an appointment was fast really flexible availability that's a big plus. The doctor was really nice and explain everything really detailed.  Staff is nice. Thank you for great service.
The most kind, gentle, and caring staff. They make the whole environment calm and less stressful for both pet and pet parent. I cannot thank the team enough for helping my senior cat.

I want to extend a big shout out to Dr. Shannon Leary and her team, especially the nurse who was working today. A few weeks ago, I found a feral kitten living in a car engine. I was trying to take him to the vet, but my usual vet asked me to quarantine him for two weeks. When I went for my check-up at Spay Illinois this Monday, they refused to handle Benji, stating that he was too feral and too wild to be treated. They gave me medication to sedate him for the next visit, but I even had to sign a consent form acknowledging that if I came back with the cat in such a feral state, they wouldn’t be able to examine him and I would still be charged the fee.

This morning, my cat had a medical condition that required an immediate vet visit, so I found Bond Vet in Wicker Park. The front desk was extremely friendly and helpful. A few hours later, I brought in Benji. To my huge surprise, he acted like a normal kitten—just a little skittish but totally manageable. I believe it's because of the magic touch of the new veterinarian. They have such a friendly and welcoming approach, and they obviously know how to handle cats, taking things slow and giving him time to adjust on his own terms.

I can't thank them enough because they saved us a few weeks of taming efforts. Now, Benji can be introduced to the rest of my cats at home and become part of the family. This place is extremely skilled and obviously feral kitten-friendly.

Nice place and good care, but outrageously expensive. Each visit is a $600 bill and $90 for a microchip, really? They charged me for a poop test when they handed me the container, not after the diagnosis. Total bait and switch and I was so disgusted that I didn’t bother asking to get my money back - good riddance. I would not visit again nor would I recommend this “boutique” vet to any sensible pet owner. It’s a racket to monetize on love for your pet.

We had a great experience with Dr. Klein. We needed to come in for urgent care and this was our first time at a Bond Vet. Everyone was friendly, professional, and compassionate. They took good care of our cat and we plan to keep coming back.
What an unbelievable experience!  Can’t say enough good things about the team.
